findings: The complete final source constructs literal target proof codes, with fixed Sigma1 total graphs, over arbitrary internal values in the stated I-Sigma-1 model. No internal proof is selected from an existential.
impIdentityCode constructs excluded middle on p in a finite sequent, then or-introduction concludes imp p p. IsFormula p remains explicit in the proof-validity theorem.

mpCode constructs the literal cut of imp p q against its negation. Both supplied Proof inputs are weakened to the exact side sequents, and neg(imp p q)=p and neg q is justified using both formula-typedness premises. It does not postulate an MP oracle.

decodedMPCode uses the exact source arithmetic implication code 4*cantor a b. The sole alias a=b=0 returns the supplied antecedent proof unchanged; all other pairs use decode_imp and total decode_isFormula.
decodedZero_isProof uses the actual literal zero decoder Mem00 implies Mem00, via the identity code. It does not claim that this target formula is syntactically free-variable-free.

The graph argument orders are out,p; out,p,q,implicationProof,antecedentProof; and out,a,b,implicationProof,antecedentProof. All graph outputs are unique for arbitrary raw inputs; proof-validity requires the explicit typed/Proof premises.

Provable wrappers only unpack the supplied proofs in Prop and exhibit the explicit constructed code. Actual ZF and ZFC callers check the intended theories without introducing a theory-consistency assumption.
